name: actix-http
integration: Gateway-local Cargo patch of the released crate. The HTTP/2 transport uses h2 0.4.21 via the gateway lock.
changes: Keep the 3.22.1 dispatch, timeout and shutdown behavior. Adapt requests and responses between Actix HTTP types and the maintained h2 transport with a private conversion of message heads.
Keep the original upstream license texts and retain the production gateway graph separately from standalone crate development tests.
